title: Controller step work bound
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a rational threshold $	au$ in $(0,1]$, define the controller step work to be $16(n+1)^2(A(	au)+1)^2$, where $A(	au)$ is the active cap at threshold $	au$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the active cap, so its mathematical meaning is unavailable.
